spans.s:
उद्धरण n. taking out or off, removing, destroying,
extricating, delivering.
उद्धि॑ m. a cert. part of a carriage.

उद्धुर a. unrestrained, extravagant, extraordinary (lit.
freed from a yoke).

उद्धूमाय्^1 pp. ˚यित filled with vapour.*
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160418. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289.

उद्धृत a. drawn up or out, raised, extracted, separated,
selected.

उद्धृतस्नेह a. from which the oil or fat has been
extracted, skimmed.
उद्धृति f. drawing out, extraction, salvation.
